target: API 37 x86_64 Android emulator with SwiftShader; no physical-device claim
harness_result: PASS: one complete native workflow; all test edits use memory repositories
integration_findings_and_fixes: The plugin's native 13.5.0 failed bundled PMTiles metadata range reads. Native 13.7.1 includes upstream fixes #4602 and #4686; a strict dependency is recorded in the app Gradle file.
Flutter encodes spaces in APK asset directory names. The space-free NotoSansRegular local path/fontstack alias preserves the original upstream glyph bytes and licenses.
Android rendered-feature query bounds use physical screen pixels, so logical Flutter bounds are multiplied by device pixel ratio.
Production readiness requires loaded style and actual rendered roads and labels, with a pending recheck for overlapping idle events and a 30-second unavailable fallback.
Unused automatic annotation managers raced with rapid picker disposal. This rendering-only slice disables annotation creation; the harness uses an explicit temporary GeoJSON/circle layer.
An invalid empty tap-event configuration was caught and removed during device testing; the final harness retains the plugin's valid tap-event defaults.
Optional transitive location permissions are removed from the merged manifest because this stage does not use device location. The inspected APK declares neither coarse nor fine location permission.

Direct Flutter integration-test runs automatically uninstalled the normal emulator app during cleanup. The pre-test SQLite backup retained every original row. The maintained wrapper now sets an explicit test-only application ID and --no-uninstall because Flutter can retain the pre-build application ID for cleanup. Exact restoration and the subsequent isolated-run preservation check are recorded before task completion.
limitations: Observed debug/emulator startup is not a performance or physical-device guarantee.
A cold emulator boot produced a System UI not-responding dialog; choosing Wait recovered. Subsequent harness checks passed without an app crash.
TalkBack, predictive Back and physical-device frame rates remain unverified.
Place labels remain unresolved strings; no search, saved pin, calculated itinerary or mobile routing service is introduced.
